tika.bio: Toronto singer, songwriter and curator TiKA is a Canadian R&B and soul artist whose work combines rich vocals, Black queer storytelling and a long-running role in the city's independent music community.

vibi.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter VIBI blends raspy vocals, confessional pop writing and polished pop production, building an international career that has included opening for Bryan Adams and songwriting recognition.

victoria staff.bio: Toronto-born and raised singer-songwriter Victoria Staff makes Canadian indie pop built around intimate storytelling, folk-leaning melodies and candid writing about relationships and mental health.

wio k.bio: Malvern emcee Wio-K is a veteran Canadian hip-hop artist whose laid-back patois-tinged flow appeared on the landmark Rap Essentials compilation, Kardinal Offishall's Ol' Time Killin' and recordings with the Monolith crew.

young stitch.bio: Toronto rapper Young Stitch is a Canadian freestyle specialist and independent hip-hop artist known for winning BET Freestyle Friday's world championship and for his work with Stealth Bomb Records and Lunch Room Poetz.
